Specifically, in line 21, the code multiplies the diagonal elements of the matrix (A[i * n]) to compute the determinant. This is incorrect because the diagonal elements of a triangular matrix are not necessarily at the positions A[i * n]. Instead, the diagonal elements are at positions A[i * n + i]. The current implementation only considers the first element of each row, which is not correct for a triangular matrix. This error causes the determinant calculation to be incorrect for triangular matrices, leading to violations of the metamorphic relations (MR1, MR2, MR3, MR4).
